subject: general
question: Divide 2310 people in three parties such that half in the first party, one-third in the second party and one-sixth in the third party are all equal.
solution:
Given:

Divide 2310 people into three parties such that half in the first party, one-third in the second party, and one-sixth in the third party are all equal.

Calculation:

Let there be P, Q, and R persons in the first, second, and third parties respectively.

According to the question,

P/2 = Q/3 = R/6 = k(let)

So, P = 2k, Q = 3k, and R = 6k

According to the question,

2k + 3k + 6k = 2310

⇒ 11k = 2310

⇒ k = 2310/11

⇒ k = 210

Now,

P = 2 × 210 = 420

Q = 3 × 210 = 630

R = 6 × 210 = 1260

∴ First, second and third parties have 420, 630, and 1260 people.
